profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Meta with expertise in iOS development
profile.summary:
I transform iOS creative concepts into polished, high‑performance apps and immersive experiences. With more than 10 years of experience building native Swift/Objective‑C applications for the iPhone and iPad, I prioritize memory footprint optimization and leverage the latest framework (Swift Concurrency) to ensure thread safety.

I have 3 year of experience in crafting and releasing 2D games (Cocos2Dx) for mobile (iOS/Android) and TV OS platforms. I am eager to expand into 3D development (Unity) and metaverse.

Experiment with advanced AI tools - including Retrieval‑Augmented Generation (RAG), Function Call, and model fine‑tuning, integrating them smoothly into existing workflows to boost productivity.
